test_patch_xpu_sdpa_drop_causal_mask: test that patch_xpu_sdpa_drop_causal_mask correctly identifies and replaces causal masks on XPU devices
run_xpu_sdpa_patch_test: run the XPU SDPA patch test to verify causal mask replacement produces correct attention output
test_scaled_dot_product_attention_with_c: test scaled dot product attention with a causal mask on XPU and compare to is_causal=True output
test_scaled_dot_product_attention_with_n: test scaled dot product attention with a non-causal mask on XPU to verify it is not patched
verify_xpu_availability: verify that torch XPU is available before running the SDPA patch test
